method.ols: Ordinary least squares of complete-record H30 on year/10 for each station's saved reference-year set; slope, classical SE and two-sided p from statsmodels OLS.
method.ols_se_caveat: The classical OLS slope SE does not include serial autocorrelation and is a lower bound on the trend's sampling uncertainty.
method.sen: Theil-Sen slope computed directly as the median of all pairwise slopes between reference years.
method.mann_kendall: Mann-Kendall S test computed directly with tie correction in Var(S) and the normal approximation with continuity correction.
method.hamed_rao: Hamed-Rao (1998) modified Mann-Kendall: detrend by the Sen slope, take ranks of residuals, use only lags whose rank autocorrelation is significant at the 5% level, and multiply Var(S) by the resulting correction. Verified to agree with pyMannKendall 1.4 hamed_rao_modification_test on all 41 stations to 1e-9; exploratory because 7-16 reference years make lag estimates unstable.
method.error_over_se: |estimate_error| divided by the station's classical OLS SE, computed from retention_geometry_cases.csv; no new model fits.
method.sign_flip: sign(reference_slope + estimate_error) != sign(reference_slope), cross-checked against the saved slope_sign_disagreement column.
method.uniform_exact: uniform_exact case rows have no estimate_error; its RMSE is taken from retention_family_summary.csv and error/SE ratios are undefined.
method.rounding: JSON/CSV keep full precision; LaTeX values are rounded for display.

calendar_changed_year_set/warm90.definition: calendar archives whose warm-season and all-year retained sets differ

calendar/warm90_zero_error.note: archives whose warm-season screening error is exactly zero; every FOEN (Swiss) empirical calendar is in this set because the real Swiss gaps are too short to change the retained year set
